title_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimteri Te Rregullt!!
description_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimteri Te Rregullt!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2 banim te nje pallati te ri te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma e gjumit me ballkon te dedikuar si dhe tualeti. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje nga zonat me te preferuara si per banim edhe per investim, pasi kerkesat per qira jane te larta. title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, 1+1 Apartment with Regular Layout for Sale!!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, 1+1 Apartment with Regular Layout for Sale!! The apartment is located on the 2nd residential floor of a new well-managed building with an elevator and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, a bedroom with a dedicated balcony and a toilet. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most preferred areas for both residence and investment, as the demand for rent is high. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
